physicalScale.normalConversion: Only intermediate UV and height convert to millimetres for renderer heighttonormal; output height remains metres.

recipes: Natural wood: species-specific linear base colors, irregular growth rings, fine fibers, correlated porous-band relief, sparse rays, finish-specific roughness and coat, separate end-grain geometry.
Figured wood: distinct straight and rift grain, cellular burl and birds-eye figures, curly/ribbon reflectance modulation, low-pass pale flecks.
Stains: separate neutral, honey, amber, cognac, walnut, espresso, and black color recipes retaining underlying grain.
Engineered wood: veneer faces, periodic thin plywood layers, particle aggregates, cork cell colors, fiberboard and paper fibers, screen-imprinted back texture.
Paint: matte/satin/gloss roughness, stippled powder coat, shallow continuous wrinkle, soft-touch sheen, dielectric binder with spatial metallic flake masks beneath clearcoat.
Laminate: opaque smooth or fine-textured resin, printed wood texture, shallow woven print, marble color veins beneath a flat resin surface.

iterations.visualReview: Parent rendered initial whiteOakClearSatin sheet on Apple M3; author inspected it and reduced growth-band and ray contrast, reduced ray coverage and scale, added per-ring phase variation and correlated fibers. Parent handles final representative visual verification.

limitations: These are procedural appearance approximations of catalog descriptions, not measured spectral or scanned reproductions.
Periodic ply edges can alias in distant views; inspect at detail scale.
Pore and fiber clusters use aggregate frequencies to avoid reproducing individual subpixel pores.
No new renderer bug confirmed during this task.
